definitions.explanation: Describes something of very large degree or amount. Typically used in formal or written contexts, especially for impact, influence, damage, effort, or contribution.

examples.japanese: {多大|ただい}な⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多大|ただい}なるご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I am grateful for everyone's tremendous cooperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多大|ただい}な⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: This accident had an enormous impact on the regional economy.

notes:
{多大|ただい} is a formal na-adjective used to emphasize large degree or quantity.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {多大|ただい}な + noun
- Formal modifier: {多大|ただい}なる + noun (more formal/literary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多大|ただい}な⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: enormous influence/impact
- {多大|ただい}な⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧: great trouble/inconvenience
- {多大|ただい}な⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧: great contribution
- {多大|ただい}な⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: extensive damage
- {多大|ただい}な⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: enormous expense

REGISTER:
Primarily used in formal writing, speeches, and business contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧ or ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ would be used instead.
